user.title: Eufy Cameras
user.description: Point at the Mega bridge. On HA OS use the VM LAN IP and port 3000 — not 127.0.0.1.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Eufy Cameras
reconfigure.description: Change the Mega bridge host/port. Use the Home Assistant VM LAN IP (not 127.0.0.1) so camera snapshots work.

hassio_confirm.title: Eufy Cameras Bridge discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The Eufy Cameras Bridge add-on was found at {host}:{port}. Continue to connect.

mfa.title: Eufy 2FA
mfa.description: Enter the verification code Eufy sent (email/SMS/app).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mega bridge. Check host/port and that the bridge is running with auth ok.
error.invalid_auth: Code rejected. Try again, or request a fresh challenge.

abort.already_configured: This Mega bridge is already configured.

init.title: Eufy Cameras bridge
init.description: Use the VM LAN IP (not 127.0.0.1). Doorbell live video is off by default — Mega often opens then drops the feed (Idle↔Streaming). Leave it off for stable stills; enable only to experiment.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mega bridge at that host/port.
